tools.tempoKeyDurationLimit: The audio exceeds the per-file analysis limit of 30 minutes. Trim it to a shorter clip and try again.
tools.tempoKeyDurationUnknown: The audio duration could not be determined. Convert the file to WAV or FLAC and try again.
tools.tempoKeyInvalidOutput: The analyzer returned an invalid result, so no values were updated. Try again; if the problem persists, review the log for details.
tools.tempoKeyNoBpm: No steady rhythm was detected, so the tempo could not be estimated. Confirm that the audio has a clear beat, or enter the BPM manually.
tools.tempoKeyTooShort: Automatic BPM detection requires at least 30 seconds of audio. For shorter clips, enter the BPM manually; the current tempo is unchanged.
tools.tempoKeyInvalidSampleRate: RBA_SAMPLE_RATE is invalid. Use 0 for the default rate, or an integer from 8000 to 192000 Hz.
tools.tempoKeyUnsupportedSampleRate: The input sample rate is unsupported. Convert the audio to WAV at 44.1 or 48 kHz and retry.
tools.tempoKeyProviderUnavailable: Automatic tempo detection requires the BPM & Key Detection plugin. Install, enable or update it in plugin management. The current tempo is unchanged, and you can still enter the BPM manually and convert.
tools.tempoKeyRbaGlibcUnavailable: The system glibc version could not be determined. Bundled rba requires glibc {required} or newer. Set PYMSS_RBA to a compatible executable.
tools.tempoKeyRbaGlibcUnsupported: Bundled rba requires glibc {required} or newer; this system has {current}. Set PYMSS_RBA to a compatible executable.
tools.tempoKeyRbaMissing: The rba analyzer was not found; the plugin installation may be incomplete. Reinstall the BPM & Key Detection plugin.
tools.tempoKeyRbaRuntimeInvalid: The bundled rba runtime metadata is missing or invalid. Reinstall the BPM & Key Detection plugin.
tools.tempo_keyDescription: Measure tempo (BPM) and musical key in batch
tools.tempo_keyEngineHint: Powered by rba (MixMeister BPM Analyzer port + libKeyFinder). BPM estimates for clips shorter than 30 seconds can be determined mainly by their duration. Prefer longer material and verify results. Each file supports up to 30 minutes.
tools.tempo_keyHint: Analysis runs locally and never modifies the source audio.
tools.workerProtocolError: Worker communication parsing failed after non-protocol output was detected: “{output}”. Restart the application and try again; open the full debug log if the problem persists.
